summary: Computes an incremental running average of input value a2 using the sample count at this+0x28 as the weighting denominator and storing the result at this+0x44. A count of zero is a no-op; a count of one stores the input directly; otherwise the weighted average ((count-1)*old_average + input)/count is computed and stored. The result is then clamped: a compare-flag branch writes 1065353216 (1.0f) and an over-range branch writes 1102053376 (22.0f). Called by sub_4C29F0.

operations.description: If the sample count at this+0x28 is zero the function does nothing.
If the sample count at this+0x28 equals 1 the average at this+0x44 is initialized directly from the input.
First-sample path: store input a2 as a float at this+0x44.
Compute weighted sum and average: ((count-1)*old_average at this+0x44 + input) / count at this+0x28.
Store the computed average at this+0x44.
If the floating-point compare flags (v6|v7) indicate the unordered/below-range case, write 1065353216 (1.0f) to this+0x44.
Else if the computed average exceeds 22.0, write 1102053376 (22.0f) to this+0x44.
Clamp path: store the lower clamp 1065353216 (1.0f) or the upper clamp 1102053376 (22.0f) at this+0x44.
